name: Ship
why: An idea, planned, tracked, built in a cloud thread, checked, reviewed, merged and given back
ideal: A plan is approved as first shown, a thread opens a draft pull request, a separate reviewer approves it, and tokens per merge fall.

sources.title: Claude Code: cloud sessions and auto-fix
Git Crafter: tracking issues and cards

steps.name: Plan
tools: Idea in Discussions or a card
steps.rule: An idea becomes a written plan the owner approves as first shown, then a fresh session builds from it.

steps.name: Track
tools: Haiku 5.5, low effort for the search
steps.rule: Each piece of work is an issue or a card, searched for first, and its pull request names it and is merged, not closed.

steps.name: Build
steps.rule: A thread builds on its own claude/ branch from the project's instructions, and a thread idle past the cache lifetime is replaced, not revived.

steps.name: Check
tools: Haiku 5.5, low effort for log lookups
steps.rule: The thread opens its pull request as a draft and watches CI with auto-fix, so a person reads it after the checks.

steps.name: Review
tools: A reviewer that did not write the change
steps.rule: A separate reviewer, which has not seen how the code was written, reads the pull request at its head commit, so few bugs escape.

steps.name: Merge
tools: Pull request to the public repo for a generic fix
steps.rule: A green, reviewed pull request squash merges, any fix other repos can use goes upstream, and each merged one costs fewer tokens.
